plugins.name: sdd
plugins.description: Provides a standardized Specification-Driven Development (SDD) methodology that ensures consistent, high-quality software development practices when working with Claude Code.

plugins.name: pace
plugins.description: Transform Claude Code into a comprehensive personal agent for diverse non-coding tasks through structured research, planning, and execution phases with intelligent context management.

plugins.name: agent-engineering
plugins.description: Cross-cutting skills for disciplined AI-assisted development based on the 10 Claude Code Principles (Forsythe). Includes correction codification, regression eval scaffolding, cross-cutting architectural decision capture, isolated git-worktree task lifecycle (create + handoff/merge), and self-contained SDD flow orchestration (no SDD plugin required).

plugins.name: langsmith-skills
plugins.description: Skills that drive the LangSmith CLI to query/export traces, build evaluation datasets, and create evaluators for your own LLM apps. Requires the langsmith CLI and a LangSmith API key. Distinct from the official langsmith-tracing plugin.
